business_scope.primary_industry_name: Programmatic Real-Time Ad Exchange and SSP Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - codified commercial law in the Civil Law tradition, with Islamic Sharia as a fundamental source of legislation under Article 2 of the Basic Statute (Royal Decree 101/1996 as amended in 2021); company law conformity is statute-based under Royal Decree 18/2019

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Law on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing) as amended; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law) Arts. 5-12 (beneficial ownership registration with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion - MCIIP); Royal Decree No. 101/1996 Basic Statute; Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT rules and Executive Regulations; Capital Market Authority resolution on beneficial ownership; implementing practice governed by MCIIP Invest Easy circulars and the National AML/CFT Committee directives

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified passport copy of the foreign sole shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of residence with authentication by the origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Oman is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; sequence is notarization, origin MOFA authentication, legalization at the Embassy/Consulate of the Sultanate of Oman, then licensed Arabic translation in Oman)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly notarized Power of Attorney authorizing the Omani incorporation agent and law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization, origin MOFA authentication, Oman Embassy/Consulate legalization, licensed Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incorporation (required if the sole shareholder is a corporate entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Register/Registrar in the home jurisdiction of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (registrar issuance, origin MOFA authentication, Oman Embassy/Consulate legalization, licensed Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds letter for the initial contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank officer signature notarized, origin MOFA authentication, Oman Embassy/Consulate legalization, licensed Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic translation of all above instruments together with the draft Memorandum of Association (MOA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed legal translation office in Oman, followed by notarization at the Notary Public Department of the Ministry of Justice
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic Omani notarization (no consular route; Arabic translation becomes the operative legal text)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing screening of all direct and ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories and managers against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Oman's domestic designations issued under RD 30/2016, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Interpol-driven adverse media sources. Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status must be assessed for any UBO holding a prominent public function within the previous 12 months; enhanced due diligence and source-of-wealth documentation are required for all PEP-tagged relationships. Screening must be repeated before every registry update and transactional trigger; records retained for at least 5 years after relationship termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy - electronic commercial registry portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) at https://investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be registered in Arabic. A Latin/English transliteration may be added as a supplementary name. The Arabic name must conform to standard Arabic phonetic and orthographic conventions, be readily distinguishable from existing registered names, must not mislead as to the actual activity of the SPC, and foreign terms must be transliterated according to an approved phonetic table unless a recognized exception applies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The initial commercial name reservation is valid for 180 days and may be renewed once for an additional 180 days through the Invest Easy portal prior to expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant has 30 calendar days from the Invest Easy notification to file a written administrative grievance with the MCIIP Commercial Registration Committee; the Committee must issue a reasoned decision within 30 days. A further ministerial appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Commerce within 15 days of an adverse Committee decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Restricted - a pure virtual/letter-box address without any physical presence does not satisfy MCIIP or municipal requirements and will prevent issuance of the Commercial Registration (CR) and the municipal business license. For an ISIC 7310 AdTech platform with no sector-specific license, a serviced office (dedicated desk or private room) with a physical signboard, dedicated Oman street address, and mail-handling arrangement is accepted as meeting registered-office and municipal substance thresholds; the entity must maintain full access to books, records, and personnel for inspection purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for standard low-risk filings: estimated 5-10% annual probability of unannounced municipal or MCIIP physical inspection. The probability materially increases to approximately 30% or higher if flag indicators are present, such as UBO disclosure inconsistencies, tax registration gaps, AML anomaly reports, or occupation of a residential/grade-D commercial building.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed legal translation office and Notary Public Department of the Ministry of Justice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of OMR 100 for standard SPC incorporation document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal incorporation, UBO register preparation, and governance advisory fixed fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark range USD 1,800-4,000 for a standard fully foreign-owned SPC with one UBO and non-licensed AdTech activity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended; Articles governing Single Person Company (Arts. 207-213); Articles 11-15 on commercial registration; Executive Regulations of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion; Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT directives for corporate account opening.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registration Directorate, acting through the Invest Easy one-stop e-portal (investeasy.mociip.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association (Contract of Incorporation), application for Commercial Registration, and the Commercial Registration Certificate issued by MoCIIP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital is imposed for this foreign-owned Single Person Company; the issued share capital stated in the Memorandum must be fully subscribed by the sole shareholder and deposited into a capital-verification account at an Oman-licensed bank. The bank issues a Capital Deposit Certificate for use in the incorporation filing. The funds are not impounded by the government as an escrow deposit and become available for company use after the Commercial Registration Certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board of the Single Person Company, acting on the written resolutions of the sole shareholder under Royal Decree 18/2019, resolves: (i) the entire issued share capital set out in the Memorandum is subscribed by the sole shareholder and the bank capital-verification certificate is accepted and lodged with the statutory records; (ii) the registered office of the SPC is fixed at the address stated in the incorporation application, and the Board directs that address to be filed in the Commercial Register; (iii) [full names] are appointed as Director and Company Secretary respectively, with authority to execute formation filings, open at least one corporate bank account, and carry out the company’s digital-advertising contracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Name Reservation and Activity Code Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Invest Easy Portal, Name Reservation Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Invest Easy portal using the sole shareholder's verified credentials; select 'Single Person Company'; enter the proposed Arabic and English trade name; select ISIC Rev.4 code 7310 with the activity description 'programmatic real-time advertising exchange and SSP platform'; submit for availability screening and pay the reservation fee. Retain the name reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Valid notarized passport copy of the foreign sole shareholder
Invest Easy account registration or Omani electronic identity
Proposed English and Arabic company name
ISIC 7310 activity description for the programmatic advertising platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as identical or deceptively similar, file an alternative name in the same portal session; if the activity classification is queried, attach a business-model statement explaining the digital advertising exchange and contact the MoCIIP activity classification helpdesk.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Notary Public, certified legal translator, and licensed Omani law firm
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct an Oman-licensed lawyer to draft the Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association. The document must specify the SPC legal form, share capital, sole shareholder, registered office address, board composition, and corporate objects limited to digital advertising trading infrastructure. Execute the document before a Notary Public; if the shareholder is a legal entity, annex its board resolution and notarized power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Arabic draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport or Commercial Register copy of the sole shareholder
Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration for each natural person controlling the shareholder
Notarized power of attorney if a representative signs on behalf of the shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a query based on unstamped pages, incomplete signatures, or an unavailable party, correct the identified document defect and re-execute all affected pages before the same Notary Public before continuing the registration process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Bank Verification Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman-licensed commercial bank supervised by the Central Bank of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary SPC capital account in the name of the company using the notarized Memorandum and Articles. Deposit the full subscribed share capital stated in the Memorandum. Instruct the bank to issue a Capital Deposit Certificate and a confirmation letter for submission to MoCIIP. Complete the bank's customer due diligence process, including Ultimate Beneficial Owner information, in accordance with Central Bank AML/CFT regulations.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Passport copies and corporate-chain details of the shareholder
Ultimate Beneficial Owner statement and declarations
Bank account opening forms and signatory appointment sheet
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional economic substance evidence, provide the executed first board resolution stating the planned Oman office, headcount, revenue streams, and client markets; resubmit the enhanced UBO declaration to the bank within the timelines fixed by the AML officer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Registration Division through the Invest Easy e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload all notarized and certified documents to the Invest Easy portal under 'New Commercial Registration'. Complete the online application with the shareholder's details, director and secretary appointments, registered office address, share capital, ISIC 7310, and digital advertising activity description. Electronically sign the statutory declaration and pay the prescribed state registration fee. Await MoCIIP review and issuance of the approval decision.
required_dossiers: Notarized Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Bank Capital Deposit Certificate
Lease agreement or title deed for the Oman registered office
First Board Resolution appointing officers and fixing the registered office
Passport copies and Ultimate Beneficial Owner declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MoCIIP issues a deficiency notice, respond within ten business days by re-uploading corrected Arabic versions of the affected documents; if the application is rejected, file an administrative review with MoCIIP's decisions committee and correct the stated statutory omissions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Commercial Registration Certificate and Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Register and General Authority for Revenue (GAR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After MoCIIP approval, pay the final issuance fee, download the provisional Commercial Registration Certificate, and verify the legal name, capital, and shareholder data. Complete GAR registration for Corporate Income Tax and Value Added Tax to obtain the Tax Registration Number, then preserve the Arabic and English CR copies in the statutory records.
required_dossiers: MoCIIP approval notice
Receipts for state fees
Draft Commercial Registration Certificate for verification
GAR tax registration forms and authorized representative details
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registration Certificate contains data errors, apply online for a certificate correction within three working days attaching the notarized Memorandum; for GAR processing delays, file an electronic inquiry in the GAR taxpayer portal and provide the approved CR number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Board Formation, Share Certificates and Corporate Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SPC Board of Directors and the chosen Oman-licensed corporate bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution to issue the share certificate to the sole shareholder, approve the authorized signatory list, appoint the compliance officer, and approve the statutory registers and minute book. Submit the Commercial Registration Certificate, Tax Registration Number, and signed board resolutions to the corporate bank to convert the temporary capital account into a fully operative operating account for the digital advertising platform.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
GAR Tax Registration Certificate
First board meeting minutes or written resolutions
Passport copies and residence evidence for officers
Original Capital Deposit Certificate and prior bank account documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate bank issues an AML query or asks for proof of economic substance, file the complete Ultimate Beneficial Owner corporate tree and the final board resolution documenting employees, office lease, and projected revenues; adopt a supplemental unanimous written resolution if the minutes are considered incomplete.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - MoCIIP Industrial Development Directorate does not mandate an industrial operating licence for an office-based digital advertising technology company. A municipal business or occupancy licence may nevertheless be required by the relevant Omani municipality if the company occupies physical office premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate manufacturing or industrial operating license is required. The operative licence for the company is its Commercial Registration Certificate, together with any local municipal office-purchase or occupancy licence for the registered office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the SPC is an office-based digital advertising exchange platform with no industrial installation, no production process, and no hazardous emissions. No Environmental Impact Assessment report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The activity produces no industrial wastewater, volatile organic compounds, or process emissions. Office waste is collected through the municipal system; decommissioned server hardware and electronic waste must be transferred to an Environment Authority-approved e-waste handler in compliance with Oman waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: If a physical Oman office is established, the company must obtain an annual fire-safety clearance from the Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority, the municipal occupancy certificate, and an employer-related occupational health declaration for general office work. For a remote or virtual registered office, the company remains responsible only for maintaining a safe remote-work policy and preserving employee workplace health records under Oman labour law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), established as the independent successor to the General Secretariat of Taxation of the Ministry of Finance; national electronic services portal 'Tax Advance' (https://taxoman.gov.om) for TIN issuance, VAT registration, returns and fiscal clearance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1 — incorporate the 100% foreign-owned SPC with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) and obtain the Commercial Registration certificate (CR number). STEP 2 — register with the Oman Chamber of Commerce (required for the municipal/industrial license). STEP 3 — apply for the corporate Tax Card/TIN through the Tax Advance portal within 30 days of the CR issuance date, attaching the constitutional deed, CR, lease deed for Omani premises, board resolution, passport copies of shareholders/directors and bank reference letter. STEP 4 — obtain a separate VAT TIN either mandatorily (annual taxable supplies > OMR 500,000) or voluntarily (supplies > OMR 187,500) through the same portal; non-resident suppliers must appoint a fiscal representative. STEP 5 — register employees with the Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI) and file statutory withholdings (CIT withholding registration) if any Oman-sourced payments to non-residents are planned.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SPC is a separate juridical person subject to corporate income tax at the entity level (general rate 15%; 0% below OMR 25,000 taxable profit and 3% on the next tranche up to OMR 100,000); the SPC is not transparent and no pass-through of income or losses to foreign shareholders is permitted. Territorial scope: an Omani-resident SPC (incorporated in Oman or centrally managed and controlled from Oman) is taxable on worldwide income; non-resident shareholders are taxable only on Oman-sourced income (dividends domestically exempt). The SPC's profits are also subject to no branch remittance tax on repatriated dividends of an SPC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman has no 'check-the-box' or hybrid-mismatch elections; entity classification follows the Companies Law. Available statutory elections: (i) fiscal unity / tax grouping election for two or more Omani resident companies connected by at least 51% ownership, subject to prior OTA approval; (ii) voluntary VAT registration election once taxable supplies exceed OMR 187,500 (mandatory at OMR 500,000); (iii) VAT input tax pro-rata deduction election for mixed-use AdTech expense pools; (iv) election to apply a non-calendar financial year only with OTA consent; (v) foreign tax credit election (unilateral credit) for foreign income taxes paid.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — enacted by Royal Decree No. 121/2020 (in force 16 April 2021) and executed under the Omani VAT Executive Regulations implementing the GCC Unified VAT Agreement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 500,000 of annual taxable supplies for mandatory registration by resident businesses; voluntary registration is available once annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 187,500; non-resident persons making taxable supplies in Oman without a fixed establishment are subject to mandatory registration regardless of threshold; branches and related persons are aggregated for threshold purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Phased statutory e-invoicing under Tax Authority Decision No. 71/2023: (a) Phase 1 — taxpayers with annual taxable supplies above OMR 10 million must exchange structured invoices via OTA-certified platforms using the PEPPOL BIS 3.0 3-corner and 4-corner frameworks with near-real-time reporting/API clearance; (b) subsequent phases cover lower-turnover AdTech SSP/DSP operators and O2C flows on the national e-invoicing portal; (c) every tax invoice must bear a validated invoice registration number (IRN-style identifier) and QR code; non-certified ERP integration is non-compliant; a transitional period prohibits double handling and allows credit-note digital matching.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: ZERO-RATED GOODS: exported goods are zero-rated if the goods leave Oman within 90 days of supply, with transport documentation and Customs Bayan export declaration evidencing removal. ZERO-RATED SERVICES: (i) international transportation and ancillary services; (ii) services directly related to exported goods; (iii) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Oman during the performance, the benefit is effectively used/consumed entirely outside Oman, and the supply is not connected to immovable property or goods in Oman. For the programmatic AdTech SSP/DSP scope, platform fees and inventory-brokerage services supplied B2B to non-resident demand-side/supply-side counterparties qualify as zero-rated exports of services; fees from Omani domestic media buyers are standard-rated 5% VAT. Oman imposes no statutory FX-repatriation deadline; export proceeds must be repatriated to the Omani operating account within reasonable trade terms (documented 180-day benchmark for intercompany AdTech revenue), and the 90-day removal rule governs goods evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan / Single Administrative Document) stamped by Royal Oman Police Customs evidencing physical exit
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill dated within 90 days of the supply and naming the Omani exporter as shipper
Signed commercial contract / insertion order with the non-resident counterparty (with payment mechanics)
Commercial tax invoice issued under the Omani VAT law with 0% VAT indication
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice from a licensed Omani bank evidencing repatriated foreign-currency proceeds
Proof of recipient's non-resident status (foreign VAT/TIN or certificate of incorporation)
ADR/continuous-transport evidence (freight forwarder bill, CMR, or customs broker report) for goods movements
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: OTA compliance campaigns match Bayan/customs declarations, bank remittances and VAT return line items; unsupported zero-rating triggers retrospective VAT assessment (5% clawback plus interest-like late penalty of 1% per commenced month), fines under the VAT Law (RD 121/2020) of up to OMR 15,000 per violation for incorrect records and statements, and imprisonment of up to three years for intentional evasion; customs authorities may additionally debit duty differentials and export-bond guarantees; voluntary disclosure through the OTA settlement program reduces penalties before commencement of an audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), Muscat; the CBO is the sole monetary, banking, and foreign-exchange supervisory authority and operates the Oman Real-Time Gross Settlement (ORTGS) system and the national Automated Clearing House (ACH). Exchange control and financial-licensing functions are exercised by the CBO's Exchange Operations and Banking Supervision Directorates under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000, as amended) and the AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree 30/2016).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for current-account transactions, and Oman has accepted Article VIII obligations of the IMF Articles of Agreement. No surrender, quota, or prior-approval requirement applies to current payments, including profit remittances. Capital-account transactions are liberalized for non-resident investors holding 100% foreign ownership under the Foreign Capital Investment Law and Commercial Companies Law, subject only to registration with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP). The sole practical hurdle for profit remittance is the 10% withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders (reducible under tax treaties) and a requirement that the SPC be tax-compliant and possess an active TIN; no CBO foreign-exchange approval is required. Because the OMR is pegged at 1 OMR = USD 2.6008 with published CBO midpoint rates, currency risk on the USD/OMR axis is negligible, but settlement must occur through CBO-licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation exists. Omani exporters may retain 100% of foreign-currency export receipts in foreign-currency accounts held at licensed banks and are free to convert or deploy such proceeds without CBO approval. There is no prescribed timeline for repatriation or conversion. For programmatic advertising services, invoices issued in USD/EUR/INR are treated as service export proceeds under CBO balance-of-payments reporting, and the bank will tag receipts with the applicable BOP service code; the treasury policy should nonetheless mandate conversion to OMR within 30 days to fund OMR operating liabilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account; supplementary Foreign Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low for OMR-denominated local clearing and medium for ancillary inbound/outbound settlement. CBO has not issued a general fintech-EMI banking license; only banks licensed under the Banking Law may accept OMR deposits or provide payment accounts to Omani-resident companies. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Revolut Business, etc.) cannot open local OMR accounts and cannot participate directly in ORTGS or the national ACH. They may be used only as supplementary multi-currency e-money wallets for settlement of ad-platform payables in USD/EUR, provided the SPC first holds a primary corporate account at a CBO-licensed bank that receives funds via SWIFT from the EMI. Legal constraints: the EMI must be a regulated payment institution in its home jurisdiction, funds routed through the primary Omani bank must pass CBO AML/CFT screening, and no EMI may hold or disburse capital reserves on behalf of the SPC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is effectively mandatory for at least one authorized signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) at account opening, because Omani bank practice and CBO AML/CFT Rulebook require face-to-face verification of non-resident corporate customers. Remote/video KYC may be used only at the individual bank's discretion for pre-screening and subsequent signatory onboarding; the first director visit to Oman for in-person meeting, original document inspection, and biometric capture is the industry baseline. If the sole foreign director cannot travel, an Omani-resident attorney-in-fact under a notarized and MCIIP/Chamber of Commerce attested power of attorney may open the account, but the bank will still require a remote video call with the UBO and a compliance interview recorded on file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed foreign-owned SPC with no prior audited financial statements and a digital-only AdTech business model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original Commercial Registration (CR), MCIIP investment certificate, articles of association, board resolution appointing signatories, UBO declaration with passport copies and proof of residence, detailed business plan covering the programmatic SSP/Ad-Exchange model, expected counterparty geographies, and financial projections for 24 months; supporting contracts with DSPs, SSPs, and advertisers; CVs and source-of-wealth statements of the UBO and shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-velocity, low-value payment flows to many foreign publishers and media agencies, characteristic of programmatic advertising.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master service agreements with a defined whitelist of publishers/SSPs, fee-schedule and waterfall documentation, sample reconciliation reports linking impressions/clicks to invoices, an internal AML compliance policy, and a commitment to provide monthly transaction-level reporting to the bank for the first 12 months of operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a non-Omani parent or shareholder for the SPC's minimum paid-up capital, potentially regarded as third-party funding by the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder funds source documentation: 6-12 months of shareholder bank statements, audited subsidiary/parent financials, signed equity subscription or capital commitment agreement, share allotment resolution, and SWIFT MT103 proof of transfer from the shareholder's own account; the injection must originate directly from the shareholder account, not from aggregated treasury aggregators.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to/from sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions (e.g., ad inventory sourced from listed territories) and potential circumvention screening through multi-hop settlement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Geographic counterparty authorization matrix signed by compliance, negative-media screening reports, proof of OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening software adoption, an undertaking that the platform excludes sanctioned parties, and a designated Compliance Officer registered with the CBO Licensing Directorate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity injection must be executed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 Cover for large interbank transfers) from the shareholder's account directly into the SPC's capital-escrow or operational account at the primary Omani bank. The purpose code on the wire must be classified as foreign direct investment in equity (IMF BOP category), with the narrative field stating 'INVESTMENT IN OMAN SPC SHARE CAPITAL' and referencing the MCIIP investment license number. The bank is required to register the inflow in CBO balance-of-payments reporting, and the SPC must maintain the corresponding capital-verification evidence for the MCIIP annual compliance filing. Funds denominated in OMR will be converted at the CBO-listed ETC (exchange transaction) rate; no CBO approval letter is required for equity injection, but the bank's AML compliance unit will match the incoming wire against the UBO source-of-funds file and the capital subscription instrument
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements to foreign publishers, SSPs, and ad-tech vendors will settle via SWIFT MT103 payments in USD or EUR through the primary bank's correspondent network, with standard fee-pass-through and same-day execution under ORTGS linkage. For larger contractual commitments to technology providers (e.g., cloud infrastructure, high-volume data services), the SPC should use commercial irrevocable documentary credits (LCs) issued by the Omani bank, typically 30-90 day tenor, to optimise float. All outgoing remittances must bear accurate purpose codes: trade-in-service codes for ad-tech fees, licence royalties for platform usage, and 'SERVICE FEES' as the MT103 narrative; payments to free-zone entities within Oman may be settled via the national ACH in OMR. For recurring publisher payouts, an automated batch file (ISO 20022 pain.001) submitted to the primary bank for same-day ORTGS/ACH clearing is preferred over manual RMA one-offs
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OMR/USD spot contracts at CBO-listed exchange rates, with same-day settlement through the CBO-licensed banking circuit

Outright OMR/USD forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months, executed under an ISDA/CBO-compliant master agreement with a CBO-licensed dealing bank; fully cash-settled against the 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD peg
USD/OMR cross-currency swaps and conventional currency swaps covering principal and coupon exchange on underlying trade-finance or capital-funding facilities

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are technically permissible in synthetic USD/OMR settings only with board-approved ISDA documentation and CBO bank counterparty approval; not recommended because the deliverable forward market is fully available at the fixed peg

Interest-rate swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) on the SPC's OMR or USD borrowings to hedge benchmark and currency basis risk, subject to the bank's credit facility and the CBO derivatives-authorization framework

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Trade License / Commercial Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) – Invest Easy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of the initial commercial registration each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal subjects the company to a fine of up to OMR 200; the commercial registration is suspended; failure to renew for 12 consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off from the Commercial Register and nullification of operating permits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (with Audited Financial Statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) – Mutasil e-filing system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the financial/tax year; for a 31 December year-end, due no later than 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to OMR 500, plus statutory interest on unpaid tax; continued non-compliance may lead to enforced collection, attachment, and revocation of tax clearance certificates required for shareholder distributions and contract awards.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and Beneficial Ownership Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) – Invest Easy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the annual Commercial Registry Renewal; any share transfer or UBO change during the year must be filed online within 10 working days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incorrect, incomplete, or late UBO filings expose the company and its statutory manager to fines under the Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree 18/2019) of up to OMR 5,000; Wholly foreign-owned SPCs may also face administrative suspension of registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based exemption: every Omani Single Person Company is required to appoint a licensed statutory auditor under Article 82 of the Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree 18/2019). The audited financial statements must be presented to the sole shareholder and submitted with the corporate income tax return; additional reporting to regulatory counterparts may be required under adtech commercial contracts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); IFRS for SMEs is permissible for non-listed entities meeting the small enterprise threshold of annual turnover not exceeding OMR 100,000 and fewer than 10 employees, as defined by MOCIIP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Commercial Companies Law, the SPC must maintain an up-to-date register of beneficial owners. The company must file any change in direct or indirect shareholding or control structure with MOCIIP within 10 working days of the event. Additionally, an annual UBO confirmation is bundled with the Commercial Registry Renewal and serves as the authoritative declaration of beneficial ownership for the reviewed year.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–700 per year for a standard registered agent and virtual office arrangement in Muscat, Oman.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–4,000 per year for an SPC with annual revenue under OMR 500,000; programmatic adtech platforms with complex revenue recognition may command a higher fee range.

stage_6.entry_description: Commercial Registration (CR) number, OTA Tax Card / Tax Identification Number (TIN), legal form (Single Person Company), capital, principal place of business, and line of business code ISIC 7310.
stage_6.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the SPC's Omani TIN and the foreign shareholder's name, home-country tax number (TRC) and ownership percentage. Do not upload UFIN/no country of residence.
